source_name: Central Registry of North Macedonia — Trade Registry (Трговски регистар)
organization: Централен регистар на Република Северна Македонија (CRM)
rate_limits: free public per-company search (basic fields); bulk/detailed data via paid distribution; hosts firewalled from this environment at investigation time
notes: Official North Macedonia company register (CRM). Free public search (Пребарување) for basic identity/status; bulk extracts and detailed data are PAID via the CRM data-distribution service. Identifiers: ЕМБС (7-digit entity id), ЕДБ (13-digit tax id), ДДВ (VAT). Catalogued from public documentation — the .mk hosts resolved via DNS (92.55.95.145) but TCP/HTTP timed out from this environment; no live values captured. Founders/managers = personal data, redact. Currency MKD.

notes: Registry of Annual Accounts — annual financial statements (Биланс на состојба / balance sheet + Биланс на успех / income statement), MKD, filed by all companies. Accessed via the CRM's paid distribution; no open bulk. Catalogued from public docs; no raw values.

source_name: UJP — Public Revenue Office (ЕДБ / ДДВ VAT)
organization: Управа за јавни приходи (Public Revenue Office)
rate_limits: per-company; returned HTTP 502 at investigation time
notes: Public Revenue Office administers the ЕДБ (13-digit tax number) and ДДВ (VAT) registration. Per-company tax/VAT verification; no open bulk. Returned 502 during this investigation. ЕДБ is the tax id; VAT is the ДДВ registration.
